title: Anatomy atlas, radiographs (AI)
description: Anatomy outlines for the Learn-mode anatomy layer (layer 'atlas') on the frontal chest radiographs of cxr-findings, cxr-findings-2, cxr-findings-3: lungs, heart, aorta, mediastinum, trachea, spine, hila, clavicles and scapulae (paired structures named by their place on the image where the file does not record the side), after automatic QC and a visual check of every film. Not reviewed by a radiologist; never used for grading. No images: targets reference those packs' series and SOP UIDs.

sources.name: Horalix (horalix.com)
sources.license: AI-generated drafts for this app; the segmentation tools and their licences are listed in docs/data/anatomy-atlas-xr-report.md
sources.citation: Thanks to Horalix.com, every structure in the anatomy layer is marked. The outlines are AI, not reviewed by a radiologist.
sources.accessNote: Unreviewed AI drafts; never used for grading.

sources.name: NIH ChestX-ray14 (ChestX-ray8), NIH Clinical Center
sources.license: Unrestricted use; link to the original download site, acknowledge the NIH Clinical Center and cite the CVPR 2017 paper (dataset FAQ, Q04)
sources.citation: Wang X, Peng Y, Lu L, Lu Z, Bagheri M, Summers RM. ChestX-ray8: Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases. IEEE CVPR 2017:2097-2106. Images courtesy of the NIH Clinical Center.
sources.accessNote: Data_Entry_2017_v2020.csv and FAQ from the official NIH Box share; BBox_List_2017.csv (984 radiologist boxes, identical count to the official list) and the selected PNGs read member-by-member (HTTP Range, CRC-32 checked) from the unmodified images_0NN.zip copies on the public Hugging Face mirror alkzar90/NIH-Chest-X-ray-dataset, because the official Box archive links no longer resolve. No login or agreement involved.

referenceTargets.label: Clavicle, image right

provenanceDetail.method: AI — automatic segmentation, not reviewed by a radiologist
provenanceDetail.note: Unreviewed AI proposal. QC passed: largest region kept; area 1.3% of the image; inside the thorax box; outline matches the model output (Dice 0.996). This film's file does not record the patient's side (no PatientOrientation), so the structure is named by its place on the image; a PA film is shown by convention with the patient's right on the image left.
